statement: A split and a merge can never be in flight on overlapping key ranges: the workflow owners refuse to register a split (or merge) whose source/target key ranges overlap an already-persisted in-flight transition's ranges — validated durably at registration (the key-range-manager contiguity authority), not by the process-local handle check that dies with a restart. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/split-merge-overlap-guard.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — overlap-refused-at-registration, durable-overlap-validation, and restart-surviving-guard receipts all passing.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Each new regression test must fail when the corresponding mechanism is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
The oracle evidence files must be written by a deterministic evidence harness that re-runs the recorded proof commands (focused test files, red-on-revert probes) and writes the receipt artifact.

The overlap guard must consult the durable transition rows (F23): the existing splitReplication/mergeReplication mutual-exclusion check is process-local and cannot see a transition another node owns or a restarted node forgot.
